changes.result: Live Z.ai Rust provider lane proven over direct browser-level CDP WebSocket through SSH to Mac mini Chrome. Rust enumerated and attached to the exact Z.ai target/context, account scope matched, then created its own new target after verifying exact origin/account scope; it observed the input event, clicked Send once, matched the expected assistant marker, read back the same chat via provider chat_id (2 messages), and closed only its created target. Failure B565f50393c844047b64e (new-target navigation race) fixed and recorded RED/GREEN evidence under plan evidence/. Commits: 8beedf96573cc6f32c3837130b748bdb34c03d0f and c22780f1315c4e75556d271964cf02007687ed13. cargo test --lib adapters::: 4 passed; isolated CDP harness: 11 passed; git diff --check passed. rustfmt unavailable in toolchain. ChatGPT live acceptance not performed; V079D remains blocked.
changes.note: Z.ai live create/send/readback complete; exactly one prompt, no retries. ChatGPT lane skipped under current stop/profile restriction; tracked separately as V079D blocked.
